li2026robodreamer.caption: Figure 2: Overview of RoboDreamer. li2026language2loco.caption: Figure 2: Overview of RoboGhost. We propose a two-stage approach: a motion latent is first generated, then a MoE-based teacher policy is trained with RL and a diffusion-based student policy is trained to denoise actions conditioned on motion latent. This latent-driven scheme bypasses the need for motion retargeting.
